description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Thumbana, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - (25/0221)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, registration of landowners, and land ownership details under the Registration of Title Act. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and other property-related particulars, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
